info.name: GitHub Gists GitHub Gists API API

description.content:
The GitHub Gists REST API provides endpoints for managing public gists on GitHub. It allows developers to programmatically list, create, update, and delete gists—which are simple ways to share code snippets, notes, and other content with others. Through this API, you can perform all the essential operations needed to view and modify gists without using GitHub's web interface, making it easy to integrate gist management into your applications or workflows.
